conventions.charts: Same charts as config/muscle_map.json. torso_front/torso_back/torso_back_top: [u, v] = [|x| in metres from the midline, height z in metres]. torso_around: [angle_deg around the trunk (0 = front, 90 = side, 180 = back), z in metres]. Limb charts (shoulder/upperarm/lowerarm/thigh/calf): [s along the segment (0 = proximal joint, 1 = distal joint), angle_deg around the segment]. All charts describe the REST pose mirrored onto the left side, exactly like the muscle map.
conventions.fan: Fibres converge on one insertion point: 'center' is the insertion in chart coordinates, 'cut_deg' is a ray direction (degrees in the metric chart plane, 0 = +u) that must NOT cross the muscle — the striation phase wraps there. 'angular_spacing_deg' is the angle between neighbouring striations as seen from the center. Striations are radial lines out of the center, so fibres visibly converge on the insertion.
conventions.limb_charts: 'angle_center' is the reference angle the chart is unwrapped around (the patch angle of the group); 'radius_m' turns degrees around the limb into arc metres. Both are per-group because the same chart serves several groups.
conventions.limits: One field per group: multi-headed muscles (triceps, biceps, quadriceps, hamstrings) are drawn as one converging/parallel field, not per-head fields. The pectoralis and latissimus tendon twist near the insertion is NOT modelled — the twist happens in the tendon, outside the muscle belly shown. Pennation angle is NOT modelled: striations follow the belly's mean fibre direction.
conventions.parallel: Fibres run parallel to 'axis' (a unit vector in METRIC chart coordinates: metres along u, arc metres along v). 'spacing_m' is the distance between neighbouring striations across the fibres. 'origin_point' is an arbitrary phase reference in metric coordinates. 'wrap': true quantises the spacing so a whole number of striations fits around the limb (no seam where the angle wraps).

adductor_longus.label: Adductor longus
adductor_longus.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
adductor_longus.origin: Body of the pubis to the middle linea aspera; the inner thigh near the groin.

adductor_magnus.label: Adductor magnus
adductor_magnus.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
adductor_magnus.origin: Ischiopubic ramus and ischial tuberosity to the linea aspera and adductor tubercle; the back of the inner thigh.

biceps_femoris.insertion: Head of the fibula and lateral tibial condyle (biceps femoris); medial tibia (semitendinosus, semimembranosus).
biceps_femoris.label: Biceps femoris
biceps_femoris.note: Down and lateral from the ischial tuberosity to the fibular head.
biceps_femoris.origin: Ischial tuberosity (long head) and linea aspera (short head) to the head of the fibula; the outer hamstring.

biceps_long_head.label: Biceps, long head
biceps_long_head.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
biceps_long_head.origin: Supraglenoid tubercle to the radial tuberosity; the lateral head.

biceps_short_head.label: Biceps, short head
biceps_short_head.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
biceps_short_head.origin: Coracoid process to the radial tuberosity; the medial head.

brachialis.label: Brachialis
brachialis.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
brachialis.origin: Lower half of the front of the humerus to the coronoid process of the ulna; shows between biceps and triceps on the outer arm.

brachioradialis.label: Brachioradialis
brachioradialis.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
brachioradialis.origin: Lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus to the styloid of the radius; the thumb-side ridge.

deltoid_anterior.label: Deltoid, anterior head
deltoid_anterior.note: Fan centre at the tuberosity, just past the far/lateral corner of the region, so fibres converge down/outward from the clavicle.

deltoid_lateral.label: Deltoid, lateral head
deltoid_lateral.note: Parallel along the arm: as seen from the tuberosity this long, narrow head subtends too small an angle for a fan (striations would alias near the insertion). The slight convergence is sacrificed for a readable field.

deltoid_posterior.label: Deltoid, posterior head
deltoid_posterior.note: Fan centre at the tuberosity (lateral humerus), seen from the posterior region.

erector_iliocostalis.label: Erector spinae, iliocostalis
erector_iliocostalis.origin: Angles of the ribs, the lateral column. Common origin: sacrum, iliac crest, lumbar spinous processes.

erector_longissimus.label: Erector spinae, longissimus
erector_longissimus.origin: Transverse processes, the middle column. Common origin: sacrum, iliac crest, lumbar spinous processes.

erector_spinalis.label: Erector spinae, spinalis
erector_spinalis.origin: Spinous processes, the most medial column. Common origin: sacrum, iliac crest, lumbar spinous processes.

fibularis_longus.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal.
fibularis_longus.label: Fibularis (peroneus) longus
fibularis_longus.note: Along the outer leg toward the ankle.
fibularis_longus.origin: Head of the fibula to the first metatarsal; the outer side of the leg.

gastrocnemius_lateral.label: Gastrocnemius, lateral head
gastrocnemius_lateral.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
gastrocnemius_lateral.origin: Lateral femoral condyle to the calcaneus (Achilles); the outer calf head.

gastrocnemius_medial.label: Gastrocnemius, medial head
gastrocnemius_medial.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
gastrocnemius_medial.origin: Medial femoral condyle to the calcaneus (Achilles); the bigger, lower inner calf head.

gluteus_maximus.insertion: Iliotibial band (~75% of fibres) and gluteal tuberosity of the femur. Fibres run inferolateral at 32-45 degrees.
gluteus_maximus.label: Gluteus maximus
gluteus_maximus.note: Fan centre lateral/inferior, at the IT-band/gluteal-tuberosity insertion zone.
gluteus_maximus.origin: Posterior ilium, sacrum, coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament, thoracolumbar fascia.

gluteus_medius.insertion: Lateral surface of the greater trochanter of the femur.
gluteus_medius.label: Gluteus medius
gluteus_medius.note: Fan converging down onto the greater trochanter.
gluteus_medius.origin: Outer surface of the ilium between the anterior and posterior gluteal lines.

gracilis.label: Gracilis
gracilis.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
gracilis.origin: Pubis to the medial tibia; the thin strap on the inner thigh.

infraspinatus.label: Infraspinatus
infraspinatus.origin: Infraspinous fossa to the greater tubercle; fibres converge up and lateral.
infraspinatus.note: Fan converging up and lateral on the greater tubercle. Cut ray points lateral (0 deg), away from the muscle, which lies medial to its insertion.

latissimus_dorsi.insertion: Floor of the intertubercular groove of the humerus. Upper fibres horizontal, middle oblique upward, lower vertical upward, all converging on the humerus.
latissimus_dorsi.label: Latissimus dorsi
latissimus_dorsi.note: Fan centre at the humerus, just anterior to the region, so the whole back fans toward the armpit. The tendon twist is not modelled.
latissimus_dorsi.origin: Spinous processes T7-L5, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, lower 3-4 ribs, inferior angle of the scapula.

obliques.insertion: Linea alba, pubic tubercle, anterior half of the iliac crest.
obliques.label: External obliques
obliques.note: Fibres run superolateral to inferomedial ('hands in pockets'): in (arc, z) coordinates the axis points toward the front and down.

pectoralis_major_abdominal.insertion: Lateral lip of the intertubercular (bicipital) groove of the humerus. Clavicular fibres run down/lateral, middle fibres horizontal, lower fibres up/lateral.
pectoralis_major_abdominal.label: Pectoralis major, abdominal part
pectoralis_major_abdominal.note: All three parts converge on the bicipital groove; clavicular fibres run down/lateral, sternocostal horizontal, abdominal up/lateral (one fan centre, three regions).
pectoralis_major_abdominal.origin: Aponeurosis of the external oblique / rectus sheath to the bicipital groove; fibres up and lateral, twisting under the others.

pectoralis_major_clavicular.insertion: Lateral lip of the intertubercular (bicipital) groove of the humerus. Clavicular fibres run down/lateral, middle fibres horizontal, lower fibres up/lateral.
pectoralis_major_clavicular.label: Pectoralis major, clavicular part
pectoralis_major_clavicular.note: All three parts converge on the bicipital groove; clavicular fibres run down/lateral, sternocostal horizontal, abdominal up/lateral (one fan centre, three regions).
pectoralis_major_clavicular.origin: Medial half of the clavicle to the bicipital groove; fibres down and lateral.

pectoralis_major_sternocostal.insertion: Lateral lip of the intertubercular (bicipital) groove of the humerus. Clavicular fibres run down/lateral, middle fibres horizontal, lower fibres up/lateral.
pectoralis_major_sternocostal.label: Pectoralis major, sternocostal part
pectoralis_major_sternocostal.note: All three parts converge on the bicipital groove; clavicular fibres run down/lateral, sternocostal horizontal, abdominal up/lateral (one fan centre, three regions).
pectoralis_major_sternocostal.origin: Sternum and costal cartilages 1-6 to the bicipital groove; fibres horizontal.

rectus_abdominis.label: Rectus abdominis
rectus_abdominis.note: Vertical fibres. The horizontal tendinous intersections ('six-pack' lines) are not fibres and are not drawn.

rectus_femoris.label: Rectus femoris
rectus_femoris.note: Bipennate in life; drawn parallel along the thigh toward the patella.
rectus_femoris.origin: Anterior inferior iliac spine to the patella; the middle of the front of the thigh.

rhomboid_major.label: Rhomboid major
rhomboid_major.origin: T2-T5 spinous processes to the medial border of the scapula, root of the spine to the inferior angle.
rhomboid_major.note: From T2-T5 down and lateral to the medial border.

rhomboid_minor.label: Rhomboid minor
rhomboid_minor.origin: C7-T1 spinous processes to the medial border of the scapula at the root of the spine.
rhomboid_minor.note: From C7-T1 down and lateral to the scapula.

sartorius.label: Sartorius
sartorius.note: Along the strap, diagonally from the outer hip to the inner knee.
sartorius.origin: Anterior superior iliac spine to the medial tibia (pes anserinus); crosses the thigh diagonally from the outer hip to the inner knee.

semimembranosus.insertion: Head of the fibula and lateral tibial condyle (biceps femoris); medial tibia (semitendinosus, semimembranosus).
semimembranosus.label: Semimembranosus
semimembranosus.note: Down and medial to the medial tibial condyle.
semimembranosus.origin: Ischial tuberosity to the medial tibial condyle; wider and deeper, shows lower and inner to the semitendinosus.

semitendinosus.insertion: Head of the fibula and lateral tibial condyle (biceps femoris); medial tibia (semitendinosus, semimembranosus).
semitendinosus.label: Semitendinosus
semitendinosus.note: Down and medial to the pes anserinus.
semitendinosus.origin: Ischial tuberosity to the medial tibia; the inner hamstring with the long tendon.

serratus_anterior.insertion: Medial border of the scapula (costal surface).
serratus_anterior.label: Serratus anterior
serratus_anterior.note: Fibres run from the ribs back/up toward the scapula; the scapular attachment is far from this region, so the field is near-parallel here rather than a fan.
serratus_anterior.origin: Outer surfaces of the upper 8-9 ribs.

soleus.label: Soleus
soleus.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
soleus.origin: Soleal line of the tibia and head of the fibula to the calcaneus; shows below and beside the gastrocnemius.

tensor_fasciae_latae.label: Tensor fasciae latae
tensor_fasciae_latae.note: Along the muscle toward the iliotibial band.
tensor_fasciae_latae.origin: Anterior iliac crest to the iliotibial band; front of the outer hip.

teres_major.label: Teres major
teres_major.origin: Inferior angle of the scapula to the medial lip of the bicipital groove; runs with the latissimus.
teres_major.note: From the inferior angle up and lateral to the humerus, alongside the latissimus.

teres_minor.label: Teres minor
teres_minor.origin: Upper lateral border of the scapula to the greater tubercle (lowest facet).
teres_minor.note: Along the lateral border of the scapula up to the greater tubercle.

tibialis_anterior.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of the first metatarsal.
tibialis_anterior.label: Tibialis anterior
tibialis_anterior.note: Parallel along the front of the shin toward the ankle.
tibialis_anterior.origin: Lateral condyle and upper lateral surface of the tibia, interosseous membrane.

trapezius_lower.insertion: Lateral third of the clavicle (superior fibres), acromion and scapular spine (middle/inferior fibres).
trapezius_lower.label: Trapezius, lower
trapezius_lower.note: Fan centred at the acromion: upper fibres down/lateral, middle horizontal, lower up/lateral.
trapezius_lower.origin: T4-T12 spinous processes to the root of the scapular spine; fibres up and lateral.

trapezius_middle.insertion: Lateral third of the clavicle (superior fibres), acromion and scapular spine (middle/inferior fibres).
trapezius_middle.label: Trapezius, middle
trapezius_middle.note: Fan centred at the acromion: upper fibres down/lateral, middle horizontal, lower up/lateral.
trapezius_middle.origin: C7-T3 spinous processes to the acromion and scapular spine; fibres horizontal.

trapezius_upper.insertion: Lateral third of the clavicle (superior fibres), acromion and scapular spine (middle/inferior fibres).
trapezius_upper.label: Trapezius, upper
trapezius_upper.note: Fan centred at the acromion: upper fibres down/lateral, middle horizontal, lower up/lateral.
trapezius_upper.origin: External occipital protuberance, superior nuchal line and ligamentum nuchae down to C7, inserting on the lateral third of the clavicle and the acromion (Gray 1918). Runs up the back and side of the neck toward the ear; 15/11 Kiệt: the old region stopped at the base of the neck, under the new trapezius volume.

triceps_lateral_head.label: Triceps, lateral head
triceps_lateral_head.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
triceps_lateral_head.origin: Back of the humerus above the radial groove to the olecranon; the outer horseshoe.

triceps_long_head.label: Triceps, long head
triceps_long_head.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
triceps_long_head.origin: Infraglenoid tubercle of the scapula to the olecranon; the inner back head.

triceps_medial_head.label: Triceps, medial head
triceps_medial_head.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
triceps_medial_head.origin: Back of the humerus below the radial groove to the olecranon; shows above the elbow.

vastus_lateralis.label: Vastus lateralis
vastus_lateralis.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
vastus_lateralis.origin: Greater trochanter and linea aspera to the patella; the outer thigh.

vastus_medialis.label: Vastus medialis
vastus_medialis.note: Oblique fibres running down and lateral toward the patella (vastus medialis obliquus).
vastus_medialis.origin: Linea aspera to the patella; the teardrop above the inner knee.

wrist_extensors.label: Wrist and finger extensors
wrist_extensors.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
wrist_extensors.origin: Lateral epicondyle (common extensor origin) to the back of the hand: ECRL/ECRB, extensor digitorum, ECU.

wrist_flexors.label: Wrist and finger flexors
wrist_flexors.note: Parallel along this head toward its tendon (15/11: each head has its own field).
wrist_flexors.origin: Medial epicondyle (common flexor origin) to the palm: FCR, palmaris longus, FDS, FCU.

references.cite: Gray, H. (1918). Anatomy of the Human Body. Public domain. Muscle descriptions: pectoralis major (clavicular fibres downward/lateral, middle horizontal, lower upward/lateral, converging on the lateral lip of the bicipital groove); trapezius (superior fibres downward/lateral, middle horizontal, inferior upward/lateral, converging on clavicle/acromion/scapular spine); latissimus dorsi (upper horizontal, middle oblique upward, lower vertical upward, converging on the floor of the intertubercular groove); deltoid (converging on the deltoid tuberosity).
references.used_for: Fan geometry of pectoralis major, trapezius, latissimus dorsi, deltoid.

references.cite: Geeky Medics. Superficial Back Muscles. https://geekymedics.com/superficial-back-muscles/ (accessed 13/11/2026). Trapezius fibres converge on clavicle/acromion/scapular spine; latissimus dorsi fibres converge onto a single common tendon.

Standard origin/insertion tables, cross-checked 13/11/2026 (e.g. https://www.teamlabbody.com/en/anatomy/muscles/ and https://humanome.co/charts/arm-muscles-chart-d216d0a4c4.pdf). Triceps brachii: long head infraglenoid tubercle, lateral/medial heads posterior humerus, all to the olecranon. Biceps brachii: long head supraglenoid tubercle, short head coracoid process, to the radial tuberosity.
references.used_for: Triceps/biceps parallel fields (fibres run along the arm toward the elbow). Facts only; no content copied.

references.cite: Precision Clinical Education. External Oblique (fibres superolateral to inferomedial, 'hands in pockets') and Gluteus Maximus (fibres inferolateral at 32-45 deg to the iliotibial band and gluteal tuberosity). https://www.precisionclinicaleducation.com/anatomy/muscles/external-oblique-4251 and .../gluteus-maximus-8332 (accessed 13/11/2026).
references.used_for: Obliques diagonal field; gluteus maximus fan centre (lateral/inferior insertion).

No geometry was downloaded, traced or derived. See docs/exercise-visual-system/OPEN_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.

CHECKED, NOT USED: OpenSim software is Apache-2.0, but individual SimTK model licences vary and were not all verified; muscle paths are via-point polylines in model coordinates, which would need a full registration to this character and still would not give surface fibre direction. See OPEN_SOURCE_AUDIT.md.
references.used_for: Nothing. Recorded so the check is not repeated.

review: Fibre directions were placed by the pipeline author from textbook origin/insertion anatomy (see references). They describe the direction of the surface striations only; they are NOT measured fibre data, NOT a dissection, and an anatomist or qualified coach has NOT reviewed them. The muscle regions themselves (config/muscle_map.json) are untouched by this file.
